mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, we have clear skies with a temperature of 63 degrees as the waning crescent moon hangs over Badger Prairie County Park.

City updates include the latest engineering reports submitted to the City Council, and residents are reminded that the Senior Center is currently looking for volunteers to help with their tri-shaw bike program for local seniors.

Today is a great day to get outside with live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena. Looking ahead, yoga is available tomorrow at Insight Wellness.
Regarding recent activity, on August 1, a traffic stop occurred late at night which resulted in a 71-year-old man being taken into custody for an outstanding arrest warrant.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Snickers Swirl. Culver's is currently closed, but they will be opening up at 10 AM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy a treat.
